newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Express wins new U.S. contract.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Express wins new U.S. contract.

text.p: U.S.-based global freight forwarder Burlington Air Express said it has been awarded the contract to handle General Instrument's U.S. domestic heavyweight airfreight.
It said in a statement that the annual contract, estimated at $2 million, covers the airfreight needs of General Instrument's manufactured cable and communications equipment divisions.
Burlington's service will also include both warehouse-to-warehouse and direct-to-customer shipping, the company said in a statement.

"Burlington Air Express has provided us with good service and competitive pricing. These were the two key factors to nominate Burlington as our heavyweight carrier," Steve Weyer, global logistics director at General Instrument, said in the same statement.
